jobs.title: Warehouse Associate
jobs.summary: Picking, staging and loading orders for next-day delivery across the Tri-State area.
does: Pick orders from the item sheet and stage them by route
Build and wrap pallets, check counts against the manifest
Load trucks in delivery order
Keep your area clean — we're an SQF certified facility
needs: Able to lift 50 lb repeatedly through a shift
Reliable — the trucks leave whether or not everyone showed up
Forklift experience helps but we'll train the right person

jobs.title: Packer — Production
jobs.summary: Filling, weighing, labeling and boxing our own products on the packing line.
does: Put on PPE: gloves, safety goggles, face mask.
Remove all food product from the packing area.
Disconnect packing equipment from power.
Remove equipment from the tables, including scales.
Remove visible food residue using brushes or cloths.
needs: Careful with weights and counts — this is a food safety job
Comfortable on your feet through a shift
No experience required; we train on the line

jobs.title: CDL Driver — Class A or B
jobs.summary: Running our own trucks across NJ, NY and CT. Local routes — you sleep at home.
does: Deliver to supermarkets, grocers, restaurants and hotels
Check the manifest and confirm delivery counts
Represent us at the customer's dock — you're often the only person they see
needs: Valid CDL Class A or B with clean driving record
Current DOT medical card
Comfortable with a hand truck and a tight loading dock

jobs.title: Forklift Operator
jobs.summary: Moving raw material and finished pallets between receiving, storage and the line.
does: Receive inbound and put away to location
Feed the packing room and pull finished goods
Cycle counts and inventory accuracy
needs: Current forklift certification, or willing to certify
Careful operator — we run tight aisles
Basic recordkeeping

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.summary: The voice buyers hear. Taking orders, solving delivery problems, keeping accounts happy.
does: Handle inbound sales inquiries.
Follow up on leads and close sales.
Maintain accurate records in Badger.
Work with marketing so sales effort and promotion line up.
Address customer inquiries and resolve issues promptly.
needs: Patient and organized under a ringing phone
Comfortable in spreadsheets and order systems
Spanish a real plus

jobs.title: Accounting Clerk
jobs.summary: Accounts payable and receivable for a business that ships every day.
does: Handle inbound sales inquiries.
Follow up on leads and close sales.
Maintain accurate records in Badger.
Work with marketing so sales effort and promotion line up.
Address customer inquiries and resolve issues promptly.
needs: Bookkeeping or AP/AR experience
Accurate — the numbers have to tie
Discreet with financial information

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.summary: Opening and growing wholesale accounts across the Tri-State area and beyond.
does: Visit your assigned territory.
Meet at least 5 clients or prospects in person.
Complete 10 meaningful customer touchpoints (the Daily 10 — see TRN-SLS-001).
Spend one hour prospecting, ideally first thing.
Log every activity in Badger the same day, not the next.
needs: Food, grocery or distribution sales experience
Willing to be on the road and on the phone
Understands margin, not just volume
jobs.extraComp: Commission on new and grown accounts, paid monthly, in addition to base salary.

jobs.title: Sanitation Technician
jobs.summary: Keeping an SQF certified plant clean enough to pass an unannounced audit.
does: Put on PPE: gloves, safety goggles, face mask.
Remove all food product from the packing area.
Disconnect packing equipment from power.
Remove equipment from the tables, including scales.
Remove visible food residue using brushes or cloths.
needs: Methodical — this job is done properly or not at all
Comfortable with cleaning chemicals and safety procedures
Food plant experience preferred, not required
